summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of restored Indonesian CBT/Ujian Online platform. Backend API testing: 54/56 tests passed (96.4%). Frontend UI testing: All major pages load and render correctly for all 3 roles (admin, guru, siswa). Found 2 critical backend bugs causing 500 errors that block some frontend interactions.

critical_bugs.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at line 1558 in server.py
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks student notification bell from loading, causes webpack overlay to block UI interactions
critical_bugs.error_log: File '/app/backend/server.py', line 1558, in notifications: if now < start: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes

critical_bugs.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at line 531 in enrich_session function
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks student exam start flow, prevents siswa2 from starting new exams
critical_bugs.error_log: File '/app/backend/server.py', line 531, in enrich_session: if now < start: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes

backend_issues.root_cause: Datetime comparison issue: Some datetime objects are timezone-aware (have timezone info) while others are timezone-naive (no timezone info). Python cannot compare them directly. The now_iso() function returns timezone-aware ISO strings, but when parsing session start_time/end_time from database, they may be parsed as naive datetimes.
backend_issues.suggested_fix: Ensure all datetime comparisons use consistent timezone handling. Either: (1) Always parse stored ISO strings with timezone info, or (2) Convert all datetimes to UTC timezone-aware before comparison using datetime.fromisoformat().replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) or similar.

integration_issues.issue: When backend returns 500 errors, webpack dev server shows error overlay iframe that blocks all UI interactions (prevents clicking on Manajemen Kelas and Hasil Saya links)
integration_issues.note: This is a development-mode issue only. In production build, this overlay won't exist. However, the underlying backend 500 errors must be fixed.

integration_issues.issue: Notification bell not visible on siswa pages due to /api/notifications 500 error

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix 2 critical backend datetime comparison bugs: (1) /api/notifications endpoint at line 1558 - TypeError when comparing timezone-naive and timezone-aware datetimes. (2) /api/sessions enrich_session function at line 531 - same datetime comparison error. Root cause: Inconsistent timezone handling when comparing 'now' with session start_time/end_time. Suggested fix: Ensure all datetime objects are timezone-aware before comparison, or consistently parse ISO strings with timezone info. These bugs block student notifications and exam start flow.
